title: Dono J NDE 9464
content: Years ago, I had a seizure in the middle of the night. I woke up, exhaled an absolute horrific scream and I felt myself exit my body. It was like a "pop" accompanied by a very loud "whooshing" noise. I flew up at an incredible speed and could see my body lying still on the mattress. I also heard what I described later as the sound of wild animals, like a horse or something. Anyway, when I "arrived" I was in a very dark place. I could see all around me but I had no form and there was nothing to see because all was black. I was there for a bit and then felt myself rushing back into my body with a "thunk" while I was in the ambulance being transported to the hospital. Then I went back to the "void" again, same thing as before. Then I woke up about 3 days later in a hospital bed with no memory of anything in between. I also felt physically exhausted. And that's it, nothing too dramatic just adding one more data point. out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Very loud "whooshing" noise; heard "wild animals, like a horse or something" / "wild horses".

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Seizure in the middle of the night.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated sequence: OBE with rapid upward movement; arrival in black void; rapid return to body ("thunk"); then back to the void again.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with rapid ascent (tunnel uncertain) → black void → sudden return into body in ambulance → back to void again → later awakening in hospital with no memory of the intervening time.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the void a second time after re-entering the body in the ambulance.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Auditory phenomena at separation: loud "whooshing" plus sounds like "wild animals"/"wild horses." Repeated cycling between body and void; return occurred while in an ambulance; later woke up ~3 days later with no memory in between.

I had no form... all was black." / "felt myself rushing back into my body with a 'thunk'."
